message.content: I've had the shortness of breath and a dry cough for about a week now. The cough is new, and I'm not bringing anything up with it. As for other lung problems, I've had rheumatoid arthritis and a scarring lung condition (interstitial lung disease) for about five years. My doctors have said the lung condition has been stable. I've also been around asbestos material in the past. I take baricitinib and methotrexate for my arthritis, and I haven't changed them. I don't have details on the rest of your questions, like fever, chest pain, smoking or recent travel, unless you ask me about them specifically.
